assumptions.FREQUENCY_RATE_INTERPRETATION_TEST_V1: Usual frequency ranges constrain expected completed sessions/week; not exact calendar-week counts.
assumptions.CONTEXT_PARTITION_TEST_V1: Four charging contexts form a mutually exclusive, exhaustive partition; total rate equals their sum.
assumptions.MONTH_CONVERSION_TEST_V1: Monthly usual rates multiply by 0.2299794661190965, using 365.25/12 days/month.
assumptions.ENCODED_BOUNDARY_INTERPRETATION_V2: Numeric envelopes use interval closures. Forced points and generated draws are checked against encoded endpoint membership; excluded or unreviewed points are not sampled.
assumptions.JOINT_RATE_SAMPLING_TEST_V1: Uniform feasible total, then shuffled context order and sequential uniform feasible allocations. This is not uniform over the joint polytope or a fitted joint distribution.

limits: Missing numerical bounds use nonnegative-domain envelopes, never observed zeros. Raw missing answers are retained.
Unresolved total/context reports are not sampled, even when other constraints imply finite envelopes.
Infinite upper bounds are JSON null and CSV blank; they are not zero or an imposed tail cap.
Projected context intervals remain coupled by the total equation; never sample their marginal bounds independently.
These draws are parameter tests, not sessions, Monte Carlo demand replicates, virtual owners or national populations.
The earlier Poisson/NB usual-week count candidates are a separate reporting interpretation and are not activated here.
No owner eligibility, energy, charger, power, scheduling or archived simulation is changed.
Scheduling must demonstrate realised completed-frequency agreement before this becomes a population simulator input.
